US.01.stem: How did the Transcontinental Railroad connect to the concept of Manifest Destiny?

choices.text: It proved that railroads were more efficient than ships
It was built primarily to transport military troops
It physically connected the nation and enabled rapid westward expansion
It was designed solely for transporting gold from California

choices.text: It increased tribal lands by 90 million acres
It had no significant effect on land ownership
It consolidated tribal lands into larger reservations
It reduced tribal lands from 138 million to 48 million acres

US.03.stem: How did Southern states use disenfranchisement methods to circumvent the 15th Amendment?

choices.text: They used poll taxes, literacy tests, and grandfather clauses that appeared race-neutral but targeted Black voters
They openly violated the Constitution without consequences, which ignores key developments that shaped the outcome

choices.text: Through vertical integration of production stages
Through government monopoly grants

Angel Island processed immigrants more quickly, which does not reflect the consensus among historians
